meta.title: ADA scholarships
meta.description: Need-based and merit-based ADA scholarships toward training and exam fees: who can apply, what a scholarship covers and how to apply.

hero.title: ADA scholarships
hero.line: Need-based and merit-based scholarships toward your ADA training and exam fees.
hero.photoAlt: Four trainees in an ADA training session practise holding a newborn, using training dolls

who.title: Who can apply
who.intro: ADA offers need-based and merit-based scholarships, so that talent and dedication, not financial circumstances, decide who can become a certified doula.
who.photoAlt: A trainee dresses a training doll on a changing table during an ADA training session
who.photoCaption: A trainee dresses a training doll during an ADA training session. August 2024.
who.enrollmentText: You are enrolled in, or accepted to, an ADA program with an ADA Certified Trainer or an Approved Training Provider.
who.commitmentText: You plan to serve Asian communities after certification.
who.languagesText: Speaking more than one language is preferred, but not required.
who.priorityText: Candidates from underserved communities, multilingual speakers and first-generation caregivers, who bring language skills and perspective to the families they serve.

covers.title: What a scholarship covers
covers.intro: A scholarship covers part or all of your training and exam fees, the largest cost for most candidates.
covers.caption: Costs a scholarship can cover
covers.note: Tuition is paid to the trainer or training provider. Exam fees are paid to ADA.

apply.title: How to apply
apply.intro: Apply once you are enrolled in, or accepted to, an ADA course.
apply.photoAlt: Candidates write the ADA written exam at desks in a training room
apply.photoCaption: Candidates at the ADA written exam. August 2024.
apply.s1Title: Get a place in an ADA course
apply.s1Body: Enroll in, or be accepted to, an ADA program with an ADA Certified Trainer or an Approved Training Provider. <link>Find an ADA course</link>
apply.s2Body: Write to <mail>{email}</mail> with your name and background, the program and the trainer or provider, a brief statement of purpose, and any relevant experience.
apply.s3Body: Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. ADA replies by email.
apply.s4Body: ADA tells you the amount, and whether it goes to your tuition, the {fee} exam fee or both. Exam dates

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: Questions about eligibility, what is covered, or an application you have sent.

cta.title: Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.
